coverage: Stored production observations. Every expected source has an explicit state: 1 observed/up, 0 read failure/down, -1 UNKNOWN/stale/missing. NoData never means healthy. Host/container and cached owner observations require the explicit host-metrics profile. HTTP before/after covers API/MCP/Telegram with the same quality mask, no causal claim. Watchdog values come from its existing bounded reads, are not a business ledger and expire after 180s. SDK/native source snapshots expire after 10s (host scrapes after45s). Missing telemetry does not prove business inactivity. Source readiness is not worker liveness. Technical monitoring does not activate browser analytics. Web HTTP has its own Node completion source and dedicated route/build/status panels, with strict sample/reset/freshness gates; SDK before/after panels retain their API/MCP/Telegram scope.

panels.title: Host available memory (fraction, keep at least 0.25)
Queue state observations
panels.description: Last owner queue sample only. Missing or >10s old is UNKNOWN; zero is observed zero. Does not prove worker liveness.

panels.title: Business exceptions observed by existing Watchdog
panels.query: inside_watchdog_value{check=~"purchases|fulfillment|notification_outbox|email_effects"} and on(check,job,instance) ((time() - inside_watchdog_observed_at_seconds{check=~"purchases|fulfillment|notification_outbox|email_effects"}) >= 0 and (time() - inside_watchdog_observed_at_seconds{check=~"purchases|fulfillment|notification_outbox|email_effects"}) <= 180 and (inside_watchdog_observed_at_seconds{check=~"purchases|fulfillment|notification_outbox|email_effects"} == on(job,instance) group_left() inside_watchdog_completed_at_seconds))
panels.description: Counts beyond existing operational thresholds, not totals or successful purchases. purchases: unknown/authorized >15m or sent/pending >25h; fulfillment >5m; outbox/email >10m. Owner payment/access diagnostics remain authoritative.

panels.description: community_operations: failed/unknown updates in last10m. Ages in seconds. Webhook pending is native Telegram backlog, not app delivery proof.

panels.title: Owner observation age seconds (stale >180)
panels.description: Timestamp belongs to actual completed Watchdog read cycle. Interrupted/deploy-skipped cycles do not refresh it. Future/negative age is invalid.

panels.title: Backup last-success age seconds
panels.query: time() - (inside_watchdog_value{check=~"backup_last_success_timestamp_seconds"} and on(check,job,instance) ((time() - inside_watchdog_observed_at_seconds{check=~"backup_last_success_timestamp_seconds"}) >= 0 and (time() - inside_watchdog_observed_at_seconds{check=~"backup_last_success_timestamp_seconds"}) <= 180 and (inside_watchdog_observed_at_seconds{check=~"backup_last_success_timestamp_seconds"} == on(job,instance) group_left() inside_watchdog_completed_at_seconds)))
panels.description: Age since latest successful systemd backup completion, unknown after reboot until known completion. Threshold8h. No backup storage inspection or restore proof.

panels.title: PostgreSQL native counts (ordinary reader)
panels.description: Only validated ordinary-role pg_catalog aggregates for inside DB. Missing stats/reset/role/source is UNKNOWN. No query text, PID, user or SQL is stored.

panels.title: PostgreSQL server/statistics epoch markers
panels.description: Microseconds. Changed epoch or decreased counter invalidates cross-epoch delta; unavailable intervals are incomplete.

panels.title: Caddy public native HTTP counts
panels.description: Actual adapted public443 server/subroute counted once. Other servers/automatic redirects validated before exclusion. Excludes pre-route parsing/TCP/TLS/HTTP3 failures.

panels.title: Caddy process epoch marker
panels.description: Process epoch in seconds; decreases/reset or changed epoch prevent an uninterrupted interval claim. Missing source is UNKNOWN.

panels.title: Owner cache parsing failure (1 means invalid cache)
panels.description: Scraper up is separate from source availability and file parsing; missing file/source is UNKNOWN.

panels.title: Web HTTP requests by build, route, method, status and completion
panels.description: Actual Node finish/close outcomes, exactly once per response; aborted streams remain aborted with the status sent before close (0 if none). Cumulative since process epoch, independent of trace sampling. Missing route series is unknown, not observed zero.

panels.title: Web HTTP active and started requests
Web HTTP process epoch and counter resets
panels.description: Process epoch changes or counter decreases invalidate cross-epoch comparison; inspect resets(inside_web_http_requests_total[5m]). SHA is present on every series. Scrape failure, gaps or stale samples are not healthy zero.
